changelog: Compact Claude-Style Model Selector: Replaced oversized sheet with minimalist Claude Android app layout, model pill in input bar, and clean item cards

Autonomous Multi-Model Dev Team: Backend Architect + Frontend UI/UX + Cybersecurity Specialist orchestrated directly on-device using Qwen with Sequential (low-RAM) or Parallel (high-end hardware) execution modes
File-First Code Generation & Instant Preview: AI generates code directly into project files with 1-tap live preview in AntiBot Inbuilt Browser and IDE editor
Inbuilt Browser Search Tool for Local Models: Equips small local models (<500MB) with live web search & documentation lookup via DuckDuckGo
Polished English Thinking Status Words: Fixed thinking indicator with rotating natural English verbs (Meandering, Pondering, Synthesizing, Architecting) and clean typewriter reveal
Fixed OpenSSL Permission Denied Error: Injected OPENSSL_CONF and SSL_CERT_FILE into environment for Extension Host and Terminal Node processes
Enhanced Theme Contrasts: Provided complete contrast tokens across all dark/neon/sapphire/oled color schemes
